paragraphs: A-ICE provides IT solutions and integrated applications for airport operations, serving airports, airlines and ground handlers. The company says it has supplied airports, airlines, ground handlers and the military with software and IT for over 25 years. Its product range is grouped by customer type, covering airlines, airports, ground handlers and cargo.

The flight information display system shows timetables, gate and baggage belt information. It connects to the central database, A-ODB, and is built to run with minimal manual entry. A contract and billing product takes on the recording and billing of aeronautical fees, which the site calls a complex task for airports. The baggage reconciliation system, A-BRS, tracks bag location within the airport, at the gate and on the plane. A-MDS carries message exchange between applications, the A-ODB and airport sub-systems.

The head office is in Italy. The company states that it has provided consultation and installation across Europe, the Middle East and Africa. It says solutions are offered in the customer's region, language and currency, complying with local and international regulation. The site puts its experience in the field at over 25 years.

quote.text: So, when you need IT simple, A-ICE can deliver.
